audience: tutors and online schools who teach in virtual classrooms with Lessonspace

useCases.title: See which sessions were held and who joined
useCases.text: The AI lists sessions with start and end time, space, participants, guests and billable seconds, filtered by time, duration, participant or space.

useCases.title: Check if a recording or transcript is ready
useCases.text: The AI gets the playback URL of a session recording and says if it is ready, still preparing or not recorded. It also gets a transcript download URL.

useCases.title: Review a space's join and leave log
useCases.text: The AI lists the sessions held in one space with who joined, left or went idle and when, and the users connected now.

useCases.title: List teachers and students of your organisation
useCases.text: The AI lists users with role (teacher, student or admin), active state and external id.

useCases.title: Launch spaces, rename sessions or set recording access
useCases.text: The AI creates a space, or reuses one, and returns a join link for one participant. It can rename a session and set who may watch its recording.
